title: i still think of her.
author: june
body:
everytime i think about her i feel like breaking down, collapsing and not working afterwards. I dont know why im still like this, its been 3 years. I made a tribute video on her funeral, Hoping that was a form of goodbye, But honestly it doesnt feel enough. So here it is.

Angel, Since you passed 3 years ago, June. I still remember when you last said goodbye to me, Hoping to see eachother again the next time we were meant to hang out.
That day, I still think about that fucking day. I wouldve grabbed your arm, and held you back and trapped you in my room, Never wanting to let you go.

Im so fucking sorry for saying no, If I could go back in time I wouldve said yes yes yes yes. A million times.
Thinking about it now, you were so perfect. And my ego saw past that. And that thought crawls down my back over and over. I still remember us going to lidcombe, Hanging near the trainstation and going to that cafe. You drinking coffee and me typically drinking monster energy drinks lol.

Everytime, I think about your smile, your laughter, your voice. your fucking hugs. I just want to punch myself in the face over and over and pull my hair out. Why did you have to go so fast.

First time you ever hugged me in J-mart in west ryde. 2022, My eyes sparked and i could not stop smiling till i went to bed. Now i yearn for your hug, your comfort and warmth. Now you're somewhere, bits of you floating around in the air im breathing in.

Im so fucking sorry Angel, I really am. I still cant fucking accept that you're genuinely gone. I even hope that sometimes you pop out, saying that its a prank. I would rather that than accept that you're genuinely gone. I cant.

But in the end, writing this wont bring you back. So ill say it since you never got to hear it from me.

I love you, I love you so fucking much. I wouldve bought you shit, cared for you. I wouldve even married you and deemed you the love of my life.

I knew you since you were born, and till you passed. And Ill continue to know you eventually when its my time to go.

I love you Angel, I will never forget you. Rest well little lady.
